facts.fact: Loi n° 47-2024 of 30 December 2024 sets a ceiling of XAF 3,500,000,000 for 2025 (2,000,000,000 capital, 1,500,000,000 recurrent) on special Treasury account n° 18, which finances projects to modernise and digitise the systems of the public-finance revenue agencies.
facts.system: Urbanisation des systèmes d'information de gestion des finances publiques, 2025 budget

note: Account is fed by the redevance informatique (Loi n° 10-2002, reset by Loi n° 33-2003) but the document shows no collection or payment at a stated date, so no acted fact.
